verses.text: Talks on the climate ran late, as the crews were packing the venue.
verses.prose: The COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, ran into overtime on Saturday as work crews packed up the venue and negotiators remained divided over fossil fuels, the Associated Press reported, and summit president Murat Kurum later presented a new text he said could win agreement, Reuters reported.

sources.title: Climate talks in overtime as nations wrestle with response to worsening global warming
COP31 climate talks close to final deal, says summit president

verses.text: Nothing of oil or of coal appeared in the last draft from Turkey.
verses.prose: A final draft released by COP31 co-president Murat Kurum, Turkey's environment minister, late on Saturday US time and in the early hours of Sunday in Antalya did not contain the words fossil, oil or coal, the Associated Press reported, and Panama said it would formally object.

sources.title: Turkey's final draft at UN climate talks doesn't mention the fossil fuels that cause global warming

verses.text: Rutte in Warsaw declared that the allies would stand with Poland.
verses.prose: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, visiting Warsaw on Saturday, pledged to defend Polish territory and said all allies stood in full solidarity with Poland after Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down there on Friday, AFP and Anadolu Agency reported.

sources.title: NATO chief pledges to defend Poland after Russian missile incursion
Allies stand with Poland after airspace breach by Russia: NATO chief

verses.text: Sixty were wounded and two were killed in the strike on Kryvyi Rih.
verses.prose: A Russian ballistic missile strike on Kryvyi Rih, President Zelenskyy's home city, killed a seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman and wounded 60 people, including six children, local officials said on Saturday, according to the Associated Press and Euronews.

sources.title: Ballistic missile attack on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine kills 2 and wounds scores
Ballistic missile attack on Zelenskyy's hometown kills two people

verses.text: Kharkiv's province was struck by a drone, and eleven were wounded.
verses.prose: A Russian drone hit a five-storey building in the Kharkiv region, wounding 11 people including two children, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said on Saturday, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: Ballistic missile attack on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine kills 2 and wounds scores

verses.text: Drones hit a Russian freighter that burned in the waters of Finland.
verses.prose: Two drones struck the Kaliningrad-bound Russian dry cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday morning, Russian officials said, and the burning vessel drifted into Finnish territorial waters as its crew was evacuated, ERR and Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Russian cargo ship on fire in Gulf of Finland after reported drone strike
Russia says Kaliningrad-bound ship struck by drones in Gulf of Finland

verses.text: Orpo of Finland affirmed that Ukraine had a right to fight back.
verses.prose: Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo confirmed that a drone strike had hit a Russian merchant vessel in the Gulf of Finland and wrote that Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor, ERR reported.

sources.title: Russian cargo ship on fire in Gulf of Finland after reported drone strike

verses.text: Thousands marched in the rain through Lisbon for wages and pensions.
verses.prose: Thousands of people marched through Lisbon in heavy rain on Saturday at the call of the CGTP union confederation, demanding higher wages, better pensions and action on the cost of living ahead of the final parliamentary debate on the 2027 budget, Africanews reported.

sources.title: Portugal: Workers brave downpours to demand a more affordable life

verses.text: Missiles, three of them, aimed at Riyadh, were stopped in the darkness.
verses.prose: The Saudi-led coalition said its air defences intercepted three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh early on Saturday, the third straight day of emergency alerts in the Saudi capital, Arab News and Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Coalition air defenses intercept 3 Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh
Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh

verses.text: Fire struck a plant in Bahrain when Iran attacked in the evening.
verses.prose: Bahrain's interior ministry said a civilian industrial facility caught fire after Iranian aerial attacks late on Saturday, causing material damage but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they had targeted US positions in Bahrain, Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack causes fire at industrial facility

verses.text: Lebanon's president called for a full withdrawal of Israel.
verses.prose: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun, speaking on the eve of Lebanon's independence anniversary, demanded that Israel withdraw from all Lebanese territory and stop its attacks, and said there must be no weapons outside state control, Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Lebanese president demands Israel withdrawal, decries Iran's interference

verses.text: Three were killed in a van that was carrying food aid in Gaza.
verses.prose: An Israeli strike on a vehicle carrying food aid in Gaza City killed three Palestinians on Saturday, according to Gaza's health ministry and witnesses, while World Central Kitchen said the vehicle was not affiliated with it and the Israeli military said it had targeted militants in the area, Reuters and Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Israeli Strike Kills Three in Vehicle Distributing Aid in Gaza, Witnesses Say
Israeli strike on vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza kills three

verses.text: Seeking a second term, the president spoke in Ibadan.
verses.prose: Nigerian President Tinubu, seeking re-election, told an APC presidential campaign rally in Ibadan on Saturday that Nigerians' sacrifices during economic reforms would soon give way to greater prosperity, according to a presidency statement published by Premium Times, while the campaign of opposition candidate Seyi Makinde said the turnout was poor.

sources.title: Tinubu campaigns in Ibadan, says Nigeria on path to prosperity
Makinde's campaign organisation criticises Tinubu over turnout at Ibadan rally

verses.text: Fire at a factory killed three people, and dozens were missing.
verses.prose: A fire at a candy factory in Serang district, Banten province, Indonesia, killed three people and left 36 workers unaccounted for, officials said, while 15 people were rescued alive, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: Fire at Indonesian candy factory leaves 3 dead and dozens of workers unaccounted for

verses.text: Deep off Maluku an earthquake struck, with no threat of tsunami.
verses.prose: An earthquake measured at magnitude 7.2 by Indonesia's meteorology agency BMKG struck the sea 43 kilometres northwest of Southwest Maluku Regency at a depth of 125 kilometres on Saturday afternoon, and the agency said there was no tsunami threat, Bernama reported.

sources.title: Magnitude 7.2 earthquake strikes Indonesia's Maluku Islands

verses.text: Trade pacts were signed in Brussels by Europe and Indonesia.
verses.prose: Indonesia and the European Union signed a comprehensive economic partnership agreement and an investment protection agreement in Brussels on Saturday, under which 90.4 percent of Indonesian tariff lines will enter the EU free of import duty, Antara and the Seoul Economic Daily reported.

sources.title: Indonesia, EU seal IEU-CEPA to boost trade cooperation
EU and Indonesia Sign Trade Pact Scrapping Over 90% of Tariffs

verses.text: Warned of a fire in an engine, a jet made a landing in Davao.
verses.prose: An Air Niugini Boeing 767 flying from Hong Kong to Port Moresby made an emergency landing in Davao, Philippines, shortly after midnight on Saturday after an indication of a possible fire in its right engine, and all 137 passengers and nine crew were safe, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines said.

sources.title: Plane makes emergency landing in Davao; 146 safe
All 146 Air Niugini plane passengers, crew safe after emergency landing in Philippines

verses.text: Health New Zealand released, as the Ombudsman ordered, its records.
verses.prose: 1News reported on Saturday that Health New Zealand had released internal assessments of dialysis capacity risks after Chief Ombudsman John Allen ruled they should not have been withheld, and that the documents rated the risk extreme in Counties Manukau, Bay of Plenty and Waikato in 2026.

sources.title: Health NZ ordered to release internal dialysis risk assessments

verses.text: Mexico captured Chapo Isidro, and violence followed.
verses.prose: Mexican authorities said on Saturday that they had captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as Chapo Isidro and listed among the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives, in Guasave, Sinaloa, and the arrest set off a burst of violence in the state, the Associated Press and Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' one of FBI's 10 most wanted fugitives
Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico?

verses.text: Bolsonaro remained in intensive care in Brasilia.
verses.prose: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, 71, remained in intensive care at DF Star Hospital in Brasilia with an acute abdominal obstruction, conscious and clinically stable with no discharge expected, according to a hospital bulletin on Saturday, UPI and Al Jazeera reported.

sources.title: Brazil's former President Jair Bolsonaro in intensive care unit
Brazil's Jair Bolsonaro in intensive care with bowel obstruction

verses.text: Agents detained two people boarding a plane in Seattle.
verses.prose: Masked immigration officers detained two people on a jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as passengers boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles, delaying it, and Washington Governor Bob Ferguson called the tactics deeply un-American, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: Immigration officers make arrests at Seattle airport in 'distressing' scene, delaying flight

verses.text: Nations conferring on killing machines closed with only a promise.
verses.prose: United Nations talks on regulating AI-powered killer robots and drones, held under the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, ended on Saturday with a weakened pledge to keep discussing new rules within two years, although about 100 countries had backed regulation, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: Nations agree to further talks on regulating AI 'killer robots and drones'

verses.text: Africa's football met in Abuja and backed Infantino.
verses.prose: At the 48th CAF Ordinary General Assembly in Abuja, Nigeria, on Saturday, Confederation of African Football president Patrice Motsepe again endorsed Gianni Infantino for re-election as FIFA president, saying he had the support of all 54 member associations, Africanews reported.

sources.title: African football reaffirms support for re-election of FIFA's Gianni Infantino
Focus shifts to Abuja, Nigeria as CAF, its 54 Member Associations and global partners prepare for the 48th CAF Ordinary General Assembly on Saturday

verses.text: England defeated the All Blacks, scoring five tries in London.
verses.prose: England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham in the Nations Championship, scoring five tries for their biggest winning margin over the All Blacks, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: England rips apart New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham in five-try statement win

verses.text: Seven tries took France past the Pumas and on to the final.
verses.prose: France beat Argentina 45-17 in Paris with seven tries to reach the Nations Championship final against South Africa at Twickenham on 29 November, the Associated Press reported.

sources.title: 7-try France beats Argentina 45-17 to reach Nations Championship final

verses.text: Racing in Vegas at night, the race went to Max Verstappen.
verses.prose: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix from pole position on Saturday night, ahead of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, Formula 1 reported.

sources.title: Verstappen wins exhilarating Las Vegas Grand Prix from Norris and Piastri

verses.text: Chasing a target in Melbourne, the hosts defeated the English.
verses.prose: Australia beat England by three wickets in a Twenty20 international at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, making 7 for 191 in reply to England's 9 for 187, ABC News reported.

sources.title: Australia win thriller to snap England's T20I streak
